text:
Praveen: Noticing a regression after the v2 push to mobile: a subset of iOS 2.1.x clients are getting 503s. Canary was at 40% for mobile when errors spiked around 01:05 UTC. Can we pause and pin critical tenants?

deploy-bot: Event: v2 canary traffic -> 40% (release r-6102). Started 1747654200. Alert: error-rate > baseline @1747654260.

Maya: Pausing rollout now. @deploy-bot pause --release r-6102 --route mobile-canary

deploy-bot: Executing pause. Canary set to 0% for mobile-canary. Tagging release: paused-mobile-1747654321.

Devon: Quick triage: gateway logs show some requests from SDK/2.1 have empty `X-Client-Version` header. Our router's v2-match requires `X-Client-Version: v2` -> fallthrough to v2 handler when missing; v2 handler today rejects legacy payload schema and returns 503.

Lina: Looks like the SDK started emitting a new user-agent variant that drops the header for background sync calls. That explains the sudden uptick.

Maya: Short-term plan: 1) Add tenant-level pins for enterprise orgs complaining (zenith-co, blue-ore). 2) Add a gateway fallback rule to treat missing header as v1 for UA matching `iPhone` + `SDK/2.1`. 3) Hold any further traffic shifts until SDK patch released.

ops-bot: Pinning tenants: `ops-bot pin-tenants --release r-6102 --tenants zenith-co,blue-ore --exclude` -> done.

Devon: Drafted edge rule to coerce header. Applying to NA/EU first:

```json
{"match":{"user_agent":"iPhone","sdk_version":"2.1.*","x_client_version":""},"action":{"set_header":{"X-Client-Version":"v1"}}}
```

Devon: Rolling patch to edge in NA/EU. Will monitor for 10m and rollback if any side effects.

Praveen: Good. Also add a short release note entry under "Paused rollouts" so CS has wording. Maya can you draft? Keep it clear: customers pinned to v1 due to SDK header bug; we are deploying edge mitigation while SDK team cuts 2.1.3.

Maya: Drafting now. Will push to `release-notes/mobile` and tag `paused-mobile-header-coerce-1747654321`.

Lina: After edge patch live: mobile error-rate down to baseline in NA. EU looks similar. We'll keep the header coercion for ~24h until SDK patch is out.

Praveen: For rollback criteria: if error-rate does not normalize within 30m or we see new client errors after coercion, we will rollback v2 mobile handler to r-6098 using `deploy-bot rollback --release r-6102 --to r-6098 --grace 3m`.

Maya: Noted. Also coordinate with SDK team: Devon, can you loop them in and get ETA for 2.1.3?

Devon: On it. Pinged `#sdk-mobile` and added a short summary plus logs. Expected preliminary ETA in 2 hours.

ops-bot: Summary posted to incident log: `incident-mobile-v2-503-1747654321` -> canary paused, tenant pins applied, gateway header coercion live NA/EU.

Praveen: Thanks team. Hold pins and coercion until SDK confirms patch is released and we've validated client behavior. Closing thread for now; will reopen if metrics change.
